verifications.note: OGJ: FGT's Phase VI expansion will add '121 MMcfd of incremental firm transportation capacity' — names the Phase VI Project and states the exact recorded capacity.

FERC certificate-application notice (Docket CP02-27-000): 'Incremental firm transportation service of up to 121,000 Dth/d summer peak volumes (85,356 Dth/d average annual)' for 'the Phase VI Expansion Project facilities' — matches the recorded 121 (summer-peak figure; 85,356 Dth/d is the average-annual figure for the same project).

resolutions.researcher_notes: Two independent sources (FERC docket filing + OGJ trade press) both give 121 (MMcfd/Dth/d summer peak) for the Phase VI Project, matching the recorded value exactly. The FERC notice's 85,356 Dth/d is the average-annual figure for the same expansion, not a conflicting number.

verifications.note: FERC certificate-application notice for the Phase VI Expansion Project: Mainline Expansions include 'approximately 5.3 miles of 36-inch diameter pipeline loops (in Baldwin and Mobile Counties, Alabama)' — the largest single diameter in the project, matching the recorded 36 in.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Only one independent source located for diameter specifically; a second targeted search (web search for '36-inch' + Phase VI) surfaced only republications of this same FERC filing, plus one unrelated NaturalGasIntel article whose 16-to-36-inch diameter range actually describes FGT's separate Phase V project, not Phase VI (checked the article's full text directly to rule this out as a false match). The Phase VI Project is itself multi-diameter — this same FERC notice also lists 30-inch (20.1 mi, FL), 16-inch (1.4+5.2 mi laterals, FL), and 6-inch (1.3 mi lateral, FL) segments alongside the 5.3 mi of 36-inch loop in Alabama — so 36 in (the recorded value) represents only part of the project's pipe, though it is the largest-diameter and mainline-loop component. Flagging tier medium and independent=false accordingly; no discrepancy with the recorded value itself.

verifications.note: FERC notice: Florida Gas requests authorization for 'incremental firm natural gas transportation service' for the Phase VI Expansion Project — confirms Fuel = Gas.
OGJ headline/body: 'FGT boosts natural gas deliveries with Phase VI expansion' — confirms Fuel = Gas for this project.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Trivially confirmed by both the regulatory filing and trade press describing this as a natural-gas transportation project; matches recorded value.

verifications.note: Southern Union Co. Form 8-K/A exhibit (Citrus Corp/FGT disclosure): 'Transmission ... [Phase VI Expansion] ... to construct 33 miles of pipeline and 18,600 horsepower of compression' — matches recorded 33.00 mi exactly.
OGJ: Phase VI Project comprises '33 miles of new pipeline' — matches recorded value.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Matches recorded 33.00 mi exactly. Note the underlying FERC notice sums its component segments to ~33.3 mi (5.3+20.1+1.3+1.4+5.2) and one OGJ piece rounds to '33.3 miles' — both within rounding of the recorded 33.

verifications.note: FERC notice: the certificate applicant building/owning the Phase VI facilities is 'Florida Gas Transmission Company (Florida Gas), 1400 Smith Street, Houston, Texas 77002' — names the direct owning entity recorded as Owner1.

Wikipedia: 'Florida Gas Transmission Company, LLC is a 100 percent owned subsidiary of Citrus Corp[oration]' — confirms the full legal entity name (with LLC suffix) as recorded in Owner1, and that it is a wholly (100%) distinct owning entity, consistent with the sheet's Owner1=100%.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Confirms the recorded direct-owner entity name 'Florida Gas Transmission Co(mpany) LLC'. Note this is the direct legal owner of the pipeline asset itself; upstream of it, the LLC is in turn 100%-owned by Citrus Corp., a 50/50 joint venture of Kinder Morgan and Energy Transfer (also confirmed on Wikipedia) — a deliberate GEM convention of recording the asset-holding entity rather than its ultimate parents, not a conflict with the recorded 100% Owner1 share.

verifications.note: Southern Union Co. 8-K/A exhibit: '(Phase VI Expansion). Expansion costs were estimated at $105.0 million' — matches recorded 105,000,000 USD exactly. (Same filing: actual costs through Dec. 31, 2003 were $73.0 million, i.e. construction was still being finalized at that point.)
FERC notice: 'The cost of the facilities is estimated to be approximately $105.4 million' for the Phase VI Expansion Project — within rounding of the recorded $105,000,000.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Two independent primary sources (SEC filing, FERC notice) match/closely bracket the recorded $105,000,000 ($105.0M and $105.4M respectively). Flagging for awareness only, not a discrepancy needing action: two trade-press pieces (OGJ 'FGT boosts natural gas deliveries...' and NaturalGasIntel) instead round to '$100 million' for this same project — the two primary regulatory/financial filings are the more precise and reliable figures and support the recorded value as-is.

verifications.note: Southern Union 8-K/A exhibit: 'The Phase VI Expansion was completed and placed in service during 2003' — matches recorded StartYear1=2003.

OGJ: FGT 'placed into service' the Phase VI expansion facilities on 'November 1, 2003' for winter service, with an earlier June 1, 2003 phased in-service date already delivered — matches recorded 2003.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Both sources confirm 2003 (with the project phased in on June 1 and Nov 1, 2003), matching the recorded StartYear1 exactly.

verifications.note: Southern Union 8-K/A exhibit: 'The Phase VI Expansion was completed and placed in service during 2003' (with three compressor-station modifications finished by early-mid 2004) — directly confirms operating status.
OGJ: FGT 'placed into service' the Phase VI expansion facilities, boosting deliveries for winter 2003 — directly confirms operating status.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Two independent sources both confirm the Phase VI Project was completed and placed in service in 2003 and has been carrying gas since; matches recorded Status='operating'. No contradiction of the sheet found anywhere in this pass.
